name: windows_send_keys
description: Send key presses or key chords to an element by ref or the focused element. Supports either `chord` (single chord, e.g., Ctrl+Right) or `keys` array (sequence, e.g., ["Ctrl+C","Ctrl+V"]).

handle.description: Optional explicit window handle; otherwise uses the focused element.

verifyFocus.description: Require verified keyboard focus on the ref's exact control before the sequence. Default true when a ref is given (keys such as Ctrl+A or Delete go wherever focus is); set false for a control that never reports focus.

expectFocusClass.description: Abort without sending unless the focused control's window class matches this exactly, rechecked before every chord. Use it for ref-less or handle-only input, which is otherwise unverified: the keys go wherever focus happens to be. Every reply names the focused class, so run once to discover it.

ref.description: Element ref from windows_snapshot (e.g., 'w1e5'). If omitted, sends to focused element.

chord.description: Single key chord string, e.g. 'Ctrl+Right' or 'Alt+F4'.
